machine_end_gcode:
G1 E-1.0 F2100 ; retract
G92 E0.0
G1{if max_layer_z < max_print_height} Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+30, max_print_height)}{endif} E-34.0 F720 ; move print head up & retract filament
G4 ; wait
M104 S0 ; turn off temperature
M140 S0 ; turn off heatbed
M107 ; turn off fan
G1 X0 Y187 F3000 ; park print head
M84 ; disable motors
machine_start_gcode:
G90                 ; absolute XYZ
M83                 ; relative E
M204 S10000 T1000   ; accel: print, travel

M104 S160                            ; nozzle to probe temp (no wait)
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature]  ; bed to temp (wait)

M117 Soak |..........|
G4 S3
M117 Soak |#.........|
G4 S3
M117 Soak |##........|
G4 S3
M117 Soak |###.......|
G4 S3
M117 Soak |####......|
G4 S3
M117 Soak |#####.....|
G4 S3
M117 Soak |######....|
G4 S3
M117 Soak |#######...|
G4 S3
M117 Soak |########..|
G4 S3
M117 Soak |#########.|
G4 S3
M117 Soak |##########|


G28                 ; home XYZ

M109 S160           ; ensure nozzle at probe temp (wait)
G34                 ; Z steppers auto-align

; UBL: load mesh, apply tilt, enable + fade
G28 Z               ; probe Z again after G34
G29 L0              ; load mesh slot 0
G29 J               ; quick tilt adjust
M420 S1 Z5          ; leveling on, fade to 5mm

; purge in service zone (garbage collector)
G92 E0.0            ; zero extruder

G1 Z5.0 F3000       ; lift Z (safe travel)
G1 Y2.0 F6000       ; go to purge Y
G1 Z0.2 F600        ; drop to purge Z

M109 S[first_layer_temperature] ; heat to print temp (wait) while parked
G1 X205.0 E19 F1000 ; purge line 1
G1 X5.0   E19 F1000 ; purge line 2
G92 E0.0            ; zero extruder

; intro line, still in service zone
G1 X65.0  E9.0  F1000  ; extrude short line
G1 X105.0 E12.5 F1000  ; extend line
G1 Y5.0 F6000          ; move away, line detaches
G92 E0.0               ; zero extruder
name: StarGraber
